meta.title: Butler File Tidy
meta.description: Classify loose files into folders by type or month: preview the plan first, move only after confirmation, undo any time. Also reports safe-to-clean temp junk on C:/D:. System dirs, plugin sources and protected trees are never touched. It also keeps an install/uninstall ledger: register what you installed, preview affected references before uninstalling, and reconcile leftovers afterwards.
